text:
Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers and machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, solving problems, and making decisions. A key part of AI is machine learning, where systems learn from data and improve over time without being explicitly programmed for every step. Deep learning goes further by using complex neural networks, inspired by the human brain, to handle massive amounts of information.

You encounter AI every day. It suggests movies on streaming platforms, powers virtual assistants like Siri or Alexa, and helps filter spam from your email. AI also improves navigation apps, recommends products online, and even assists doctors in diagnosing diseases. While still evolving, AI is already making life more convenient and efficient.
